headline: Work placements, teacher safeguards, Truth and Reconciliation
digest: Ottawa committed up to $162M for 10,000 Mitacs AI work placements. The CTF published policy recommendations on children's data, cognitive offloading and AI companions. Minister Solomon framed trust as the foundation for adoption. Actua's AI Exchange gathered educators from three countries at TMU, Actua marked the National Day for Truth and Reconciliation, and Amii profiled AI work amplifying African voices.
